newsitem.title: FRANCE: BUBA WOULD REACT IF DOLLAR ABOVE 2 MARKS - STOIBER.
newsitem.headline: BUBA WOULD REACT IF DOLLAR ABOVE 2 MARKS - STOIBER.

text.p: Bavarian premier Edmund Stoiber said it would be hard for the Bundesbank to accept a dollar rose above two marks, financial daily La Tribune reported on Thursday.

"If the dollar was to climb over two marks, it is difficult to see how the Bundesbank could not react, with all the negative consequences for Europe," Stoiber was quoted as saying."Better to avoid reaching that point."
At 0746 GMT on Thursday, the dollar was trading at 1.8400 marks.
